photo_orientation: Top view: RJ45 at upper-left, microSD at upper-right, main GPIO header horizontal between the RTC area and LCD.

0.header: main GPIO header, LCD-side row, silk PC2

1.header: main GPIO header, RTC/SD-card-side row, silk PC3

2.header: main GPIO header, LCD-side row, silk PC4

3.header: main GPIO header, RTC/SD-card-side row, silk PC5

4.header: main GPIO header, LCD-side row, silk PC6

5.header: main GPIO header, RTC/SD-card-side row, silk PC7

6.board_load: board RGB red LED, low level lights LED

7.board_load: board RGB green LED, low level lights LED

uart.header: on-board CH340 route; photo-visible UART jumper block must select USART1 PA9/PA10

ground: DSLogic GND to any board GND pin on the main GPIO header; never connect a DSLogic channel to a power rail.
notes: PC2-PC7 are photo-audited exposed GPIO header signals. STM32CubeF1 family pin definitions confirm their GPIO capability; board photo is the authority for physical location.
PB5 and PB0 are intentionally retained despite LED loads. Observer logical active is physical high; this is anti-correlated with the low-active LEDs and must be retained in metadata.
PC0, PC1, PB10, USART3 and phase1-pinmap-v1 are retired and fail validation.
